note.es: corrida 07:47 UTC = franja 07:30 (pre-london), pero hoy es domingo CT/UTC y ese slot solo vigila lun-vie, asi que no habia corrida del Session Analyst que rehacer; buena noticia: el snapshot se recupero -- builtAt ahora a solo 182 min (04:45Z), el cron sa-bus-snapshot de Netlify volvio a correr tras el corte que dejo la corrida anterior en 'down' (1715 min); ind-ingest/orb/webhook siguen a ~2086 min porque Globex sigue cerrado desde el cierre del viernes 21:01Z hasta la reapertura del domingo ~22:00Z (17:00 CT) -- se dejan en 'stale'/'lento', no 'dead'/'silencioso', porque solo reflejan el cierre semanal, no una falla (orb no frozen: fecha y PDH/PDL de los 5 simbolos coinciden con command); news se refresco junto con el snapshot (18 eventos, 182 min) -- fresca; zonas tacticas del plan latest todas con reach ratio <=0.259, sin alcance inalcanzable; heartbeat sigue en la corrida 'weekly' del sabado 15:19Z ok:true; journal sigue parado en 2026-10-05, ahora 133 h, siguen faltando martes-viernes de la semana pasada -- unico motivo real del warn
note.en: 07:47 UTC run = the 07:30 slot (pre-london), but today is Sunday CT/UTC and that slot only watches Mon-Fri, so there was no Session Analyst run to redo; good news: the snapshot recovered -- builtAt is now only 182 min old (04:45Z), Netlify's sa-bus-snapshot cron resumed after the outage that left the prior check at 'down' (1715 min); ind-ingest/orb/webhook still sit around 2086 min because Globex remains closed from Friday's 21:01Z close until the Sunday ~22:00Z (17:00 CT) reopen -- kept at 'stale'/'lento', not 'dead'/'silencioso', since that only reflects the weekly closure, not a failure (orb not frozen: date and PDH/PDL for all 5 symbols match command); news refreshed alongside the snapshot (18 events, 182 min) -- fresh; the latest plan's tactical zones all show reach ratio <=0.259, nothing unreachable; heartbeat still shows Saturday's 'weekly' run at 15:19Z ok:true; journal is still stuck at 2026-10-05, now 133 h, still missing last week's Tuesday-Friday -- the only real reason for the warn
